checks: no userinfo, query including lone ?, fragment including lone #
path segments unencoded; reject any % in path, dot/dotdot segments, doubled slash

endpoint_policy.comparison: exact output bytes == profile.model_config.endpoint == host provider.Endpoint; preserve exact config provider/model/ref and credential-ref/revision; no URL normalization aliases/retry/fallback

lexical_decisions.scheme: Require literal lowercase https:// prefix and url.Parse absolute https scheme/nonempty authority; reject opaque URL, backslash/control/space, userinfo, query even lone ?, fragment even lone #.
lexical_decisions.host: ASCII DNS hostname spelling/case preserved; host case-insensitive comparison may validate hostname identity but cannot rewrite original baseURL or relax exact profile endpoint binding. Valid IPv4 and localhost-style ASCII host accepted with HTTPS. Unicode IDN refused because no pinned conversion dependency; preencoded valid ASCII xn-- hostname accepted without DNS/network lookup.
lexical_decisions.port: Absent allowed; present must be nonempty ASCII decimal digits and numeric1..65535 (no sign). Preserve supplied digits including leading zeros; do not infer/rewrite explicit443 into absent port.
lexical_decisions.ipv6: IPv6 only bracketed and parseable by net.ParseIP; optional valid numeric port. Reject unbracketed literal, malformed brackets, zone identifiers including %25zone; no DNS or address reachability probe. Preserve valid input IPv6 spelling, no address rewrite.
lexical_decisions.path: Root/empty or unencoded normal segments and at most one trailing slash. Reject raw percent escape/RawPath, dot or dotdot segment, double slash, backslash and control/space. Reject case-insensitive final /chat/completions with optional trailing slash. No host/base/path normalization.
lexical_decisions.derive: Trim exactly one accepted trailing slash then append /chat/completions. Config stores original baseURL; runtime profile endpoint must equal this derived string byte-for-byte.
